now.title: Doctor Strange
now.text: Strange's watch cracks in his car crash, and he keeps wearing it.

proposed.text: Strange's watch cracks when muggers beat him in Kathmandu, and he keeps wearing it.

changes.evidence: Doctor Strange: Strange still has the watch intact after the car crash and keeps it when he sells his other possessions. Its face is damaged when thugs beat him in an alley in Kathmandu while he refuses to hand it over, and Mordo returns the cracked watch to him. The crash did not crack it.

now.title: Thor: The Dark World
now.text: The Warriors Three help Thor end the war on Vanaheim and smuggle Jane off Asgard.

proposed.text: The Warriors Three help Thor end the war on Vanaheim, where Hogun stays behind with his people. Fandral and Volstagg then help smuggle Jane off Asgard.

changes.evidence: Thor: The Dark World: after the Battle of Vanaheim, Thor lets Hogun stay with his people on Vanaheim. Only Volstagg and Fandral go back to Asgard and help Thor break out with Loki and Jane, so the record wrongly includes Hogun in the escape.
